inp=[[8]*8 for _ in range(30)]
sevens=[(1,6),(3,7),(5,0),(5,7),(9,2),(12,2),(12,4),(17,6),(20,7),(21,5)]
for r,c in sevens: inp[r][c]=7
out=[row[:] for row in inp]
for r in range(30):
    for c in range(8):
        if inp[r][c]!=0 and inp[r][c]!=8: continue
        row9s=[cc for cc in range(8) if inp[r][cc]==7]
        col9s=[rr for rr in range(30) if inp[rr][c]==7]
        between = any(a<c<b for a,b in zip(row9s,row9s[1:])) or any(a<r<b for a,b in zip(col9s,col9s[1:]))
        if between: out[r][c]=3
for row in out: print(row)
import json
print(json.dumps(out))
